Your first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the guard was checking trucks in by hand, writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

One thing to check before the postmortem: the SUP-5380 ticket's update log has an entry at 08:12 on 3 Aug ("Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn."). That is earlier than your 10:42 channel post. The ticket doesn't say who wrote it or what time zone it uses, so confirm it against the ticket system before you cite 08:12 as the first report.
